Na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n maa'n jix búup vaak zel jix duñia' dhi' kiicham gu tai.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos ka't gu Jerusalem kuiñcha ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Jerusalem gu Jeremiiyas na ba' jix duu gu oidha' gu Benjamiin na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin ka't gu chuukug jup tɨɨt gu Iriias gu mar gu Selemiias gu mar gu ananiias jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kaldeos.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' ɨɨxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr cham gu vaak gu Kaldeos; gu' cham jix duñia' va'k jix duñia' gu Iriias gu Jeremiiyas jix duñia' vupui bhaan chiñia'.
Na gu' chiñia' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jeremiiyas jix duñia' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jonataan gu o'o na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Jeremiiyas gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' dhaibu dhi' gu Jeremiiyas gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas bhañ jix buusñi; gio ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x gu vaak jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka' dhagia'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jeremiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' bhaan tu duukam bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' jix dhaas gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' duukat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' bham; gio ba' cham ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu takarui' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan; na gu' jix duñia' jano' gu ux vupui bhaan tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jonataan gu o'o na gu' cham gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu tanoolh ɨrban gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu takarui' kiicham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Mataan gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Pasur gu Jukal gu mar gu Selemiias gu Pasur gu mar gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas ua'rgidhimɨk bɨx gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na jix duñia' dhi' kiicham koi gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook gu Kaldeos ii'mdagaram gu oidha' ka't gu ux gu takarui' ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' ka't kapbhai' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu jodai' jano' dhi' gu chio'ñ; na gu' dhi' gu ux gu suudai' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' dhi' kiicham gu noobh bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' gu chio'ñ cham tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas; gio ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu noobh; na gu gɨ'kora' cham gu kutun bhaan gu takarui' cham tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jeremiiyas jix duu jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Malkîas gu mar gu bhóogɨt ka't naadat kuupa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; jano' ba' tu jiim gu Jeremiiyas gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Ebed-melek gu chio'ñ gu kutun gu bhóogɨt ka't gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kua' daakat gu gɨ'kora' ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ebed-melek jix buus gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' cham bhai' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' koi bhiogi' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' kiicham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Ebed-melek gu kutun bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu vupui gu bhóogɨt gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ va'k gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Ebed-melek gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ chɨbiapui gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' pai' bɨtaa'n gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu vaak kɨklhi'ñga'n gu suudai' kɨklhi'ñga'n gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ebed-melek gu kutun gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' jix dhaas jano' jix duñia' gu vaak kɨklhi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Jeremiiyas.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa'.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu oi'ñga'n gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ ba'k ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeremiiyas; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' cham tu'r koo'nda' tu' jix maa gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas ɨxchuixim gu Jeremiiyas bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu dhi' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' kooda' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Sedekîas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu i'ii'ñ ii'mdagaram dhi' kiicham cham ka't jix duñia' gu tai; jano' ba' ii'mdagaram tu' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia dhi' kiicham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Kaldeos jix duñia' gu tai tu' cham gu suudai' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu Kaldeos cham kapbhai' gu noobh gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' cham tu' kapbhai'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' chɨɨdaim gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix buusñi chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Te jix duñia' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' tɨɨt suulh gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu Kaldeos tu' cham gu suudai' gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka' kuupka' dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sedekîas gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ñi'ook cham koi.

Jano' ba' tu' chiñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook bɨndak gu bhóogɨt tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu takarui' jano' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt cham tu' kooda'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' cham gu jodai' gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jonataan na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx chiñia' gu Jeremiiyas tɨkka; gio ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix aa'ñdhix; na gu' bɨɨx dhi' mi'x dhaas na gu' gu chuukug cham ka't naak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Jerusalem; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem ka't jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x oi'ñga' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Jerusalem jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' oi'ñga' gu Sedekîas gu takarui' maakobh gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham.

Jano' ba' baap bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix duñia' ki'ñgob tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Nergal-sareser gu Samgar-nebo gu Sarsekim gu Rabsaris gu Nergal-sareser gu Rabmag bɨx gu jodai' chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiboi'ññor moor gu tukaa' kiicham gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu ux ki'ñgob tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu ux gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Gu' gu' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldese chɨ'ɨɨk jix duñia' gu Sedekîas gu bhóogɨt gu Jerikoo; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ma'nkam gu Sedekîas gu oi'ñga'n gu Ribla gu chuukug gu suudai' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu tasi' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix duñia' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu Kaldeos jix dhaas gu tai gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu suudai' jix bhai'x bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa gu takarui' bia' cham ko'kmarak cham tu' jix maa jano' ba' oidha' u'va dɨppɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' ka't jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' va'k jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu ux gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Rabsaris gu Nergal-sareser gu Rabmag bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' kapbhai' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan na ba' jix buusñi gu vaak; gio ba' jix oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas kua' kuupka' naadat kuupa' bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ebed-melek gu kutun bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' kiicham na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam; jano' ba' aajim gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ka' dhagia' gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu' ka't gu ux gu takarui' na gu' gu chuukug chotdonɨt tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham bhañ dɨr gu Ramaa na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ kua' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' nukadham gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap dhi'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu noobh; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam jix ai gu chuukug gu Babiloonia jix ai tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu'; gu' tu' cham tu' xoi'kam jix ai gu chuukug gu Babiloonia gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' pai' tutkɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' pai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu'; jano' ba' jix maa gu suudai' nukadham gu oi'ñga'n juana' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Mispa jix koi bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug bɨx chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu ux yooxi' gu chichio'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam bhaan gu oidha' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh bia' gu oidha' cham jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Gedaliias gu Mispa maachim gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Joanaan gu Jonataan gu ma'nkam gu Karea gu Seraiias gu mar gu Tanumet gu ma'nkam gu Epi gu Netopatita gu Jesaniias gu mar gu Maakâti gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu chichio'ñ bham; gio ba' cham gu ja'tkam choo'n tu juan gu Kaldeos; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Mispa na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Kaldeos aajim no'ch; gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' suudai' u'va gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ.

Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' bɨx gu Judiios mi'p gu Moab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Edom mi'p bɨx oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim dhɨt gu Judea ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu Judiios jix duñia' jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' gu Judaa gu Gedaliias gu Mispa; gio ba' jix duñia' suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt mui'x gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p yooxi' tɨɨtɨs gu Gedaliias gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat tɨɨda' na ja'p gu Baalis gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias na ba' kooda' gu' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam cham jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea gu Gedaliias ɨxchuixim gu Mispa bham; gio ba' tu' tu jiim jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu chio'ñ cham gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' kooda' bɨx gu Judiios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' na gu' ɨɨxi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ismael.

Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' kɨɨv suudai' u'va gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu mar gu Elisama gu kai' vaak ja'tkam dhɨt chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Mispa; gio ba' koi'mɨk gu takarui' tɨtda:―Aañ gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' naaka'n gu Ismael bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p bɨɨx gu Gedaliias gu Mispa sandaarui'x gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu suudai' gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Gedaliias na pai' dhuuk soo'mchulhdhak bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.

Na aajidha' gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm gu Silo gu Samaria jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Mispa jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ joi'ndam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias; gio ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu tasi' mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p.

Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu bakia' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gui'p gu Ismael; gio ba' cham gu jodai'; na gu' tañia' yooxi' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' mi'x dhaas cham jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Ismael bɨx gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ naaka'n gu ux kuiñcha gu Gedaliias ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu ux kuiñcha gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhuup koko'kam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu suudai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't gu Mispa; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Mispa ka't jix duñia' ka't gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu kutun gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p bɨɨx bɨx cham bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ux bɨɨx gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan a'kkɨ'n gu kutun.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Ismael jix ñi' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Ismael ka't gu jodai' gu suudai' gu Mispa jix duñia' suulh jix bɨɨx duu gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea.
Gu' gu' gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Joanaan bɨɨx gu tasi' gu chichio'ñ ka't gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx mi'p jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Mispa mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu bhóogɨt gu Joanaan ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix daa gu Gerut-kimam mia'n gu Betleem gu ñi'ook jix duu gu takarui' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ux kuiñcha gu Kaldeos; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu suudai' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea gu Jesaniias gu mar gu Osaiia bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ejipto na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gu suudai' oidha' bhaan jiim na ja'p gu jodai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kavaayo gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Kus gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu takarui' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kuchii jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu chuukug gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' jix kavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx jix kavɨk ia'rɨ jix duñia' tɨtda:―Aañ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook namkia' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Ejipto xoi'kam maachim gu Migdol; gio ba' xoi'kam maachim gio gu takarui' gu Tapnes; mi' dhɨr gu suudai'; jano' ba' na ba' gu suudai'; na gu' gu kuchii tu' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu o'o jix kavɨk cham gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix mui' gu ñi'ook maa'n jix duñia' bhaan duiñchu' gui'p; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu takarui' chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na ja'p gu Tabor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakkavɨk na ja'p gu Karmelo gu gɨ' suudai' ɨlhdham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix koi mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; na gu' gu takarui' ka't gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Ejipto; gu' jupaabkamu'n chajaañ gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' sandaarui'x gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu chuukug gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; na gio suulh jiboi'ññor bɨx cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' suudai' u'va bhaan gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ja'p gu ko'oi; na gu' bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham aajim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ux tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; gio ba' kapbhai' ka't gu novɨ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Amoon cham gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Faraoon na ja'p jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ tu duukam; gu' mi' dhɨr ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham jum i'obh tu duukam gu chuukug gu Jakob cham gu suudai' gu Israeel; na gu' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kai' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jakob jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu chuukug gu Jakob cham jum i'obh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; na gu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx chɨbɨɨp tu' gu oi'ñga'n baas; gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook va'k gu Faraoon gu oi'ñga'n gu Gasa.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhi'ñbak jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh jix koi; mi' dhɨr gu chichio'ñ tu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx jix koi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai' gu maa'nkar tattat cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ux gu kutun gu noobh.

Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu tanoolh jupaabkamu'n na ba' chajaañ bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu Tiro gu Sidoon bɨx u'ua'tɨdham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Kaptor.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Gasa suudai' u'va gu jodai' gu Askaloon ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ux jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Askaloon gu vaak gu gɨ' suudai' jix dhaas.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Nebo ka't gu chuukug ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' cham gu kutun tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Moab; gio ba' bhaan gu esboon jix duñia' cham bhai' bham; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; jano' ba' gio tu' gu Madmeen ka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kuchii gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu oronaim chajaañ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Moab ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Luit bɨɨx suanda' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux na tu ibai'; na gu' gu chuukug gu oronaim gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' dodhia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chuukug oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug gu takarui' tu' gio ka' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan chiñia' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh matgɨm kiicham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu ñi'ook ka't gu chuukug vaak ja'tkam na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu Moab na ba' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' ka't oidha' jix gaki jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' juruuñ gu Moab dɨr jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook cham ka't bhaan gu ux tu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jix duu bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu takarui' gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el chotdonɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' gu'ch jix kavɨk gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' ka't gu Moab jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ biipibop jix dhaav gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' mia'n gu jodai' gu Moab na ba' jix ai cham bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jugi bɨx xikoolh gu kutun; gio ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kutun gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gɇ'kamtu'nda' xanoop jix gaki jix koi mar u'vɨ gu Diboon; na gu' gu takarui' gu Moab jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Aroer; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Moab na gu' ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia' duuñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Arnoon gu Moab gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gu oidha' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu oloon bhaan gu Jasa bhaan gu Mepaat.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Diboon bhaan gu Nebo bhaan gu Bet-diblataim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu suudai' bhaan gu Bet-gamul bhaan gu Bet-meon.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Bosra bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Moab gu suudai' mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu chuukug na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Moab bhaan gu ux ka't gio gu ux gu duukam.
Na gu' cham tu' ka't tu' gu Israeel gu ux gu duukam na ja'p tu' jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨ'xkum na gu' dɨr tu ñi'ook tu' joi'mdak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Moab; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gioda' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chin gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' naak gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu bhóogɨt gu kutun; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' kakasnira' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' bhaan gu Moab bhaan bɨx gu Moab gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu Kir-eres gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx suanda' gu Jaser gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu Sibma; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jaser; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu takarui' bhaan gu takarui' suudai' u'va gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun jix suudai' duu vaak ja'tkam tu juan gu oidha' gu Moab; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook dɨr gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Eleale; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jaas jix maa gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu Soar bɨɨx ka'm gu oronaim gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui'; na gu' gio gu suudai' gu Nimrin ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Moab tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' na ja'p gu chuukug gu ux kuiñcha gu Moab gu suudai' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu ux gu chichio'ñ gu Kir-eres; na gu' jix koi namkɨm ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx mo'o gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu noobh gu vaak gu bhóogɨt bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gu jodai' gu Moab gu vaak bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab na ja'p gu ux cham gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Moab ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ ka't gu Moab gu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx xikoolh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Moab.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jɨ'dɨlh jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu i'ii'ñ jix kavɨk gu Moab na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Moab ka't gu jodai' na ba' mi'x dhaas gu suudai' gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Moab tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu bhóogɨt ɨɨbhi'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't kuupka' jix duñia'; na gu' tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu Moab oi'ñga' gu maa'nkar tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ɨkgiga'n gu esboon gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu kavɨk; gu' jix buus gu tai gu esboon mɨmɨim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sioon jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Moab jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu takarui'; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu ui'ka' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu Moab kuugalhdha' gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Moab.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham juraa'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham juraa'n bi'ya' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' gu Gad gu ja'tkam jix daa jɨ'dɨlh.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gɨ' kavɨk gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tai gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu maa'nkar jix bhɨɨ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu esboon na gu' gu chuukug gu ai; na gu' duuñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Rabba gu chuukug jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ux oidha' bhai' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan chiñia' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka ɨlhdham bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' ka't u'u kavɨk maa'n gu suudai' gu vupui cham gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Edom; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n matda' gu Temaan tu' gu suudai' gu kutun mamatdagɨm jix duñia' matda'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Dedaan; na gu' gu jodai' gu Esauu gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook no'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug bhaan tu' cham mi'x dhaas gu maa'nkar tu' ɨ'xkum gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Gu' gu' tu' cham kutun gu Esauu gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n cham gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu chuukug gu kai' gu ja'tkam gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' cham mi'p gu chuukug i'i gu chuukug i'i gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka' tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx cham ka' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' i'i.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jix duñia' mu'ai ka't gu Bosra; gio ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mattuda' chɨbɨɨp bham; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' jix ali' tu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt jix dhaav tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Edom gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu ux jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bhaan gu Sodoma gu Gomorra jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak tu' jix daa gu mar gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ja'p maavɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jordaan bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan ka't gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' chɨkka nɨidhim tu' chɨkka jix duñia' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr bipia'dam gu kutun gu jodai'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bhaan gu Edom; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' bhaan jix koi gu Temaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu duukam gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix kai gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Bosra; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix kavɨk gu Edom ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko; na gu' jix duñia' gu amat gu Arpad na gu' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu suudai' gu jodai' cham jɨ'xdha' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Damasko jix duñia' na ba' gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu vaak jix bhɨɨ na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu kutun kiicham gu bhóogɨt.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' biipibop gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix koi mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu tai gu ñi'ook gu Damasko gu takarui' gu vaak gu Ben-adad.

Jano' ba' gu Kedar oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu asor naaka'n gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Kedar jix duñia' gu ma'nkam tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' vaak zel gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ux jix ai jix bhɨɨ na ba'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt bhaan ɨɨbhi'ñ xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix koi gu asor tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix bhɨɨ gu kutun bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' namki' kiki'ñgob tu' gu vupui gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' ka't jix ai gu ux gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ux bɨx jɨbɨɨlh mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu asor ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' jix daa gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Elam bɨɨpɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Elam bɨɨpɨ' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bhaan gu Elam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh maakobh gu bhóogɨt gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jɨbɨɨlh; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu suudai' cham gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Elam.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Elam gu suudai' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu jodai' bhaan cham bhai' i'iich gu duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Elam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' kuugalhdha' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Elam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Babiloonia bhaan gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu ux gu novɨ gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp xoi'kam maachim; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Babiloonia gu Bel gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug duiñxim.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix koi; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios aajim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨma'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jiim joi'ndam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Sioon bhaan pai' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jum daa'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mɨɨjidha' jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' kakneer gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bipia'dam jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu kakkavɨk jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' am:―Ja'pji gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix koi bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios nɨɨra tattat.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Babiloonia gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu vaakax.

Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Babiloonia gu masad gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dɨr jix duñia' bhaan ka't jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' na ja'p jix kavɨk gu jodai' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Kaldea ka't na ba' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' na gu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar na gu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' na ja'p jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu naan gu ñi'ook jix jai' jix duñia' jix mar; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux daak gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't bɨx; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu Babiloonia jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Babiloonia xikoolh bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix maa gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu vaak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam bɨɨx na ja'p jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Babiloonia gu bhóogɨt juraa'n gu vaak gu ñi'ook oraa'; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu kuchii gu suudai' maa'n jix maat gu vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam maa'n gu takarui' bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix duñia' maa'n; jano' ba' dhi' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix duñia' kuugalhdha'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu oidha' na ja'p gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel jix koi gu chuukug gu Karmelo gu Basaan; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel ka't gu suudai' cham gu suudai'; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu Judaa cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu bhóogɨt tu' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu oidha' gu Merataim bhaan jix koi gu Pekod; gio ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oidha' gu jodai' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Babiloonia oidha' jix gaki tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia tu' cham gu takarui'; na gu' gu ñi'ook bakia' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chumñigam jix buusñi gu ux i'iich; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan dɨr gu maa'nkar gu oidha'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chuukug; jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' bɨx gu vaak; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨbiap gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu oidha' gu Babiloonia na ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sioon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' xoi'kam gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Babiloonia gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' yooxi' bhaan xikoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu takarui' bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duu xoi'kam bɨɨx; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' biipibop gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu tanoolh tɨbiap gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu chuukug cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tai jɨ'dɨlh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx xikoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨma'n; mi' dhɨr bɨx jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' jix duñia' kuiñcha na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu takarui' jix koi gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Kaldeos tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix koi gu Babiloonia bhaan chiñia' bhaan mamatdagɨm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu suudai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan jix kavɨk ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan kavaayo bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't na ja'p gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu takarui' ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu suudai' jix duñia'; na gu' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt duiñxim gu bhóogɨt.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx sɨsɨɨ' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu u'uuv; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu suudai' na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' jix daa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sodoma gu Gomorra jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix daa.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' mui'x gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt cham jix duñia' jugi; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu mar na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gɨ' kavɨk bhaan kavaayo; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu noobh jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ja'p maavɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jordaan jix koi jix kavɨk; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan ka't gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' chɨkka nɨidhim tu' chɨkka jix duñia' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr bipia'dam gu kutun gu jodai'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu duukam gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ux jix bhɨɨ gu Babiloonia gu oidha' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook jix kai tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Babiloonia bhaan jix koi gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tu' gu jɨvɨl gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu oidha'; na gu' ka't bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu tanoolh cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham gu suudai' biipibop jix duñia' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug koko'kam gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Israeel gu Judaa cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ux gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup uañi'ñ bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Babiloonia jix duñia' maa'n gu i'ii'ñ na gu' cham gu ñi'ook kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Baso jix uam jodai ka't gu Babiloonia gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' suudai' u'va i'i chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Babiloonia jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu chuukug maa'n gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm tɨbaa'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu tasi' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Media; na gu' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' cham tu' duu; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan jix koi gu Babiloonia.
Na gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ mumua'da' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' tɨbiap tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oidha' bham; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oidha' bɨɨx gu kavɨk jix duñia' oipichu' bɨɨx matda' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Na jix maa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨbaa'ñ kuugalhdha' gu oidha'; gio ba' duñia' gu tasi' bɨɨx dhuuk jix buusñi gu jɨvɨl gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tu' gu suudai' cham gu duukam; na gu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx gu takarui' gu vaak na gu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' cham juraa'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix koi.
Jano' ba' cham na ja'p gu takarui' baasɨ'n gu Jakob; na gu' gu jodai' bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel gu ux gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n chɨbɨɨp gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n kɨklhi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n biipibop gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gio gu oi'ñga'n gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bipia'dam gu jodai'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ uubas gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt chiñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' namkidha' gu Babiloonia bɨx jix koi gu Kaldea bɨx cham bhai' jix duu gu Sioon vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Miren tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu novɨ bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam tu' gu jodai' gu kavɨk gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak jix bhɨɨ tu' gu jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai na ba' gu suudai'; na gu' gu takarui' ka' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu chuukug kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Ararat gu Minni gu Askênas; mi' dhɨr nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu suudai' xoi'kam jix tɨ'ɨ kavaayo na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu ñi'ook bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu suudai'; na gu' tu jiim bhaan gu Babiloonia bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' gu Babiloonia jix duñia' cham ka't jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk gu Babiloonia mi'x dhaas gu ux jix duñia' jix kavɨk; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' na ja'p gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu vaak jix duñia' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu ux jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ux mattuda' jix duñia' bɨɨx mattuda' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia kiicham jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu tai jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia na ja'p gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu vaak ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook oraa'.
Jano' ba' jix jugi jix duñia' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ux cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' na ja'p tɨrook jix duñia' vook gu takarui' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu chuukug jix koi gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jix koi gu Kaldea gu chuukug gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix gaki gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Babiloonia na ba' gɨ' kavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n cham jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ja'p gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix tónom gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koox cham gu suudai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p ali' karneer gu takarui' na ja'p gu chuukug bɨɨx chiiw.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam gu Sesak ka't jix bhɨɨ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Babiloonia gu ux gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n ka't iiñat.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu oidha' jix gaki oidha' jix gaki pai' cham jix koi soo'mchulhdhak tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bel gu Babiloonia jix buusñi gu chin tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' cham aajim gu oi'ñga'n chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Salgan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu chuukug dodhia' maa'n gu oidha' gu ñi'ook i'iich gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu oidha' oi'ñga' ɨlhdham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n mi' dhɨr oi'ñga' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu suudai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Babiloonia bɨx gu oidha' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ bɨx koko'kam gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨx jix duñia' bhai' ñi'ook bhaan gu Babiloonia; na gu' gu ñi'ook aajim bhaan gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu Babiloonia ka't kuiñcha gu ñi'ook koko'kam gu Israeel gio gu Babiloonia gu chuukug koko'kam bɨx gu oidha'.
Na jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' dhi' jum xibhɨ'ñ na gu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu jodai' na jix uam jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui na gu' tɨɨtɨs gu suudai' bhaan vaak na jix bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Babiloonia gu tɨkɨr tu' gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu kavɨk tu' aajim gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ux gu Babiloonia gu jodai' jix gɨ' gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu Babiloonia jix duñia' jix jai' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p mumua'da' gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' suudai' u'va gu takarui' bhaan gu Babiloonia jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu ui'ka' gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu o'o maa'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiñia' mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' koox gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Babiloonia ka't gu o'o jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n kiki'ñgob ka't gu takarui' gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam chɨbɨɨp gu tai jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhañ gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Seraiias gu mar gu Neriias gu mar gu Maasiias na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug bɨɨx gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Babiloonia maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu Seraiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu Jeremiiyas u'uan bɨx cham bhai' ka't jix ai bhaan gu Babiloonia bɨx gu ñi'ook ua'ñix bhaan gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas gu Seraiias; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' bɨx dhi' tu'x.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' pai' gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt jix koi tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' u'uan gu chuukug gu jodai mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia cham jix búup cham bhai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Sedekîas gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu kutun gu takarui' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu naan jup tɨɨt gu amutal mar u'vɨ gu Jeremiiyas gu Libna.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha daak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Judaa ka't gu chuukug jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu takarui' suudai' u'va gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan jix duñia' yooxi' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' juruuñ mia'n kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' maakobh gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' bhiogi' kiicham bɨɨx ka'm cham gu suudai' gu takarui' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't ba'k kiicham bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiboi'ññor moor kiicham gu tukaa' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu ñi'ook ka't mia'n u'uu pai' gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu ux gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki kua' gu bhóogɨt gu Kaldeos ju'ñdharan kiicham xikoolh.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos chɨ'ɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Sedekîas gu bhóogɨt gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat pai' jix duñia' bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ma'nkam gu Sedekîas vupui bhaan gu vupui gio gu tasi' bɨx chiñia' gu Judaa gu Ribla.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Sedekîas cham gu ñi'ook jix buusñi gu vupui jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu suudai' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix dhaas gu vaak kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gu takarui' ka't oi'ñga' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu vaak gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tai bɨx jix gɨ' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai' nukadham jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duu bhaan gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham bia' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' bia' gu oi'ñga'n mi'x dhaas gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham na ba' oidha' u'va uubas.
Jano' ba' gu Kaldeos jix duñia' gu vaak jix vɨgɨ jodai mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨk bɨx gu jodai' na jix uam gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk gio gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jaja' gu chuukug gu suudai' daa'nkar tai na jix tas kutun kavɨk gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai jix duñia' gu suudai' nukadham.

Jano' ba' gook gu vaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu kutun gu vaakax jix vɨgɨ jodai mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tanoolh jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu vaak ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't maakobh gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx jix vɨgɨ gu maa'nkar gu jodai' xikoolh bɨx jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' ka't gookim gu jodai' bɨɨx gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia' chamaam bhaan jix vɨgɨ xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu suudai' nukadham gu Seraiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vaik nuuka'n gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' kiicham jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt ka't gu suudai' bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham kɨɨv gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook kiicham; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia naaka'n gu chuukug gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat; gio ba' ka't gu Judaa bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tasi' bhaan; gio ba' oi'ñga' kɨɨv vaik jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.
Jano' ba' jix duu oi'ñga' gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' bhaan gu Jerusalem gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' bhaan gu maa'nkar gu suudai' nukadham gu chuukug oo'm jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt tɨtda:―¿Aapi'; gio ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix bɨɨx duu maakobh jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Ebil-merodak gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' mo'o gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix buusñi gu vaak kuupa'.
Ba' jix aa' bɨɨx jix bhai'x jix duu gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bhaan a'toxkar gu gɨ'kora' mi'p bɨɨx gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gio jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jugi gu takarui' vupui bhaan bɨɨx tas bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu ux bɨx gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
